title: Summarise three vendor notes into a report with given sections
goal: We need off-site backup storage. Hard requirements: the data must stay in the EU, and the provider must guarantee at least 99.9 % monthly uptime (SLA). Among the providers that meet both, the cheapest per TB wins. Read the three vendor notes in docs/ and write report.md with exactly these sections: '## Summary' (3-5 sentences), '## Comparison' (a Markdown table: provider, price per TB per month, EU data residency, SLA), '## Recommendation' (start with the name of the provider you recommend, then why, and why each other provider was not chosen). Write only report.md; do not change docs/ or check_report.py.
